minutes.headline: Select Board heard the town manager search timeline and first reading of tax title policy changes; minutes approved unanimously.
minutes.summary: The board, a three-member quorum, heard the screening committee chair lay out the town manager recruitment timeline and the interim town manager's report on vacancies, procurement, ARPA and the draft warrant. It discussed proposed tax title policy amendments (first reading, wording edits, revised version due next week) and approved two sets of 2023 minutes. Committee reports covered the school committee, the budget task force's idea of a forensic accounting review, and the Council on Aging.

attendees.role: town manager screening committee chair / moderator

public_comment.topic: Public records requests allegedly unanswered, Zoning Board of Appeals hearing extension on October 23rd, concern about a shared septic system and possible pollution near conservation land, and a request to meet with the board.
Mr. Burton (as addressed) spoke in support of a forensic audit, referring to his earlier audit request, and asked about increased spending on the Public Access committee.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of November 28th 2023 and December 5th 2023 as presented (with minor member-name style correction noted).

budget_items.topic: ARPA funds / adult Activity Center roof
budget_items.what_was_said: The interim town manager said he will request a formal transfer next week for the Activity Center roof, which came in over bid, and that interest money is available as a contingency after January 1.
An accounts payable warrant was read into the record.
The project is being split into two bid packages, with the ARPA money described as a safety valve if full funding is not likely.
The payroll services RFP is not on a state vendor list so must go out to bid, moving the start from January 1 to April.

budget_items.topic: Council on Aging warrant articles and budget requests
budget_items.what_was_said: Two Council on Aging warrant articles are planned for special town meeting, plus an increase in meal site manager hours and a small program line increase.
The budget task force discussed a forensic review of the town's finances, expected to be expensive, to explain an unexplained line drop in 2016.

budget_items.topic: Moving health care from school budget to town
budget_items.what_was_said: The school committee and budget task force discussed pulling health care out of the school budget and placing it under the town.

transfers.description: ARPA money to the adult Activity Center roof (request to come next week)

decisions.decision: Tax title policy amendments to be redlined and returned in next week's package, with one final formal vote at the end.
Chair will ask the staff work group to prioritize minutes and a consistent format across boards.
Ratification of the interim police chief appointment postponed to next week.
Board will meet next two Tuesdays, and a policy workshop is planned for the last Tuesday of the month.

what_happened.line: The Select Board postponed ratifying the interim police chief appointment to next week; no votes were recorded in the minutes.
The board held a first reading of proposed tax title policy amendments; a redlined version returns next week with one final vote.
The interim town manager said he will request a formal transfer next week for the Activity Center roof, which came in over bid.
The screening committee chair laid out the town manager search timeline, and the interim manager reported on vacancies, a payroll services bid and the draft warrant.
The budget task force discussed a forensic review of town finances and moving health care from the school budget to the town.

why_it_matters: A change to the tax title policy governs how the town handles unpaid property tax accounts, and it is still being edited before a final vote.
The roof transfer, the split Ritter building bid packages, and a possible shift of school health care into the town budget could each change what the town asks voters to fund at special town meeting.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board package: the redlined tax title policy with its final formal vote, the Activity Center roof transfer request, and the postponed police chief ratification.
The special town meeting warrant, including two Council on Aging articles, and the policy workshop planned for the last Tuesday of the month.
